dimensions.evidence: authorize an increase of the retirement age for members of the Capitol Police

dimensions.assessment: Allows individual officers to continue working past previous retirement limits if approved by the Board.
dimensions.evidence: authorizes the Capitol Police Board to increase the mandatory retirement age for a member of the Capitol Police to up to age 62
